rebase_context.onto_note: origin/dev after #1558 merge; shared-nothing CAS prefixes entered trunk
rebase_context.tip_purpose: restore W0-A R-DOC reachability after rebase conflict; union-merge with #1558 CAS prefixes

contrarian_challenges.challenge: Should dual-critic re-APPROVE after rebase, or demand a full re-review of every file?
contrarian_challenges.resolution: Re-APPROVE is valid when tip delta is conflict-resolution only and substance is re-verified. Here: tip commit restores reachability union; ADRs/specs/R-DOC gate/catalog/founder ratification re-checked and unchanged in intent; W0-B surfaces still absent. Full re-verification of fail-closed properties performed; not a rubber-stamp of stale head alone.

contrarian_challenges.challenge: Is union-merging reachability-registry a systems smell (global mutable file friction)?
contrarian_challenges.resolution: Yes it is a known global-mutable surface (artifact-accountability tests document this). ADR-0555 deliberately makes registration a review-visible design act. Union of independent prefixes (W0-A R-DOC package vs #1558 CAS packages) is the correct concurrent-lane resolution, not a scope expansion into either product domain.

contrarian_challenges.challenge: Should architecture ADRs be Accepted before any engine exists?
contrarian_challenges.resolution: Yes for W0-A. Door one-way binds procedure and forbids fork/hand-patch; explicit 'not in force' and W0-only authorization prevent decision-as-implementation fraud.

contrarian_challenges.challenge: Is R-DOC mostly dormant (all completed=false) and therefore theatrical?
contrarian_challenges.resolution: Partially dormant by design. Live now: mandatory wave registry, baseline headers, empty-corpus RED, live_tree scanned_population>=6, affected-set wiring. Proportional for W0-A admission.

contrarian_challenges.challenge: Default PORT at rank 10 over-admits packages before SourceModel exists
contrarian_challenges.resolution: enumeration_state pending_source_model_manifest; fail_closed no-match blocks admission/generation/activation. Default is a future resolution rule, not a claim packages are ported.

contrarian_challenges.challenge: Masterplan MPV2-0045..0052 pretends W0 is done
contrarian_challenges.resolution: Sequencing notes: no wave dispatch/baseline carveout; founder ratification fail-closed; W1+ unapproved. MPV2-0045 is this admission; 0046+ remain future.

contrarian_challenges.challenge: Merging W0-A now couples k8s governance to CAS trunk and creates hidden dependency
contrarian_challenges.resolution: Only shared surface is reachability-registry accounting prefixes — independent cells. No shared runtime, no shared engine, no shared credentials. Systems blast radius of admission remains governance/docs/build-time gate only.

systems_findings.assessment: Neutral oya-port planned at build/port-engine/*; corpus policy at specs/k8s-port/**; k8s owns destination capability. No engine landed this PR. Sound shared-nothing intent retained.

W0-A prefixes (ci/facade/k8s-program-docs/, docs/programs/k8s-port/, specs/k8s-port/) coexist with #1558 CAS prefixes (infra/nativelink/, infra/talos/BUCK, …). Prefixes are additive and non-overlapping. Correct concurrent-lane merge of independent design acts.
Bootstrap go/packages+go/types out-of-band only; verify() must never invoke Go toolchain; snapshot_digest required axis. Plan intact; implementation W0-B.

Single oya-ci-required; no alternate protected status; ADR-0634 class-G unavailable; CLI non-authoritative. Harness currently BLOCKED while oya_ci_required missing on rebased tip — correct fail-closed merge posture.
affected-set maps docs/programs/k8s-port/**, ADR-0637/0638, port-rules paths, k8s-port JSON, founder ratification to R-DOC gate. Gate remains wired after rebase.
Identity-set no-growth and canary exclusion from product denominators remain doctrine for later waves; not activated by W0-A admission.
Talos W0-D + third corpus before W1 exit still force engine neutrality — systems anti-Kubernetes-lock-in preserved.

systems_findings.boundary: blast radius of this PR / tip
systems_findings.assessment: Governance/docs/build-time gate only. No runtime services, no regenerable port corpus, no Cargo members for engine. Tip commit only restores registry reachability. Safe admission cell.

suggestions.note: When rules land, ensure R-DOC + correspondence gates cannot green with zero rule fixtures (canary + selecting fixture already doctrined).
Parallel fan-out capacity-gated in ADR-0637 until owned-runner evidence — preserve hard stop so review load cannot starve oya-ci-required.
Documented concurrent-lane friction. Prefer small additive prefix patches with explicit union rationale (this tip does). Avoid wholesale registry rewrites that drop foreign-lane anchors.
Exact-head oya-ci-required must re-green on c744a2f45; do not treat prior head SUCCESS as transferable across force-push.

whats_done_well: Clean producer/consumer direction: k8s producer, os consumer via k8s/ports/**; engine has zero capability crates (still unbuilt).
Six-axis verify() tuple elevated to acceptance invariant, not prose decoration.
Doctrine-first divergence with ledger growth limit and no silent skips.
Reachability union is the systems-correct resolution of two independent accounting cells after #1558 landed on dev.
Catalog and registry non-claims prevent the gate from being misread as wave-completion proof.
